exceptions.reason: The pull request that ports the Base UI cases of `useDismiss` adds the test helper.
The file makes each popup with the test helper `useFloating` of Base UI, which Vase UI does not have. The pull request that adds `useFloating` ports the cases.

exceptions.title: focus management in nested lists
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs the case only in jsdom. jsdom does not focus the first item at the open, and a browser does, so the keys of the case reach other items in a browser. The block `lists below the list in the component tree` opens a list below with its key, moves in it and closes it with its key, in a browser.

exceptions.title: prop getters are memoized
exceptions.reason: `setup` runs one time, so the composable makes the getters one time and their identity cannot change. React makes new getters when a props object of the list changes. A new case covers the half that applies: a getter reads the current props of an entry that changes.
